visible_days_hint: Days shown in the Schedule grid.
default_lead_hint: How many days ahead deadlines show up in To-do. You can change it for each one.
hero_line: Your courses, your week and your to-dos in one place. Everything revolves around what you are taking this term.
hero_note: All you need is a Google account.
feat_subjects_title: Every course, with its own color
feat_subjects_text: Section, professor, Drive notes and task progress. The course color identifies it across the whole app.
feat_schedule_text: Classes and activities on a weekly grid, with public holidays marked and cancelled classes one tap away.
feat_tasks_text: To-dos grouped by day, with subtasks, priorities and deadlines that show up just early enough.
feat_calendar_title: Midterms, finals and assignments in one month
feat_calendar_text: Each kind of date has its own border. Make-up exams stay on hold until you need them.
feat_grades_text: Coursework and final grades in one table. The simple and credit-weighted averages update on their own.
feat_sessions_text: Pomodoro or long blocks, with today’s tasks on the side and a history of what you studied.
add_subject_hint: With its color, section and professor.

archived_banner: Archived courses don’t appear in Schedule, To-do or Calendar. Their grades still count towards your overall average.
archived_empty_text: When a term ends, archiving its courses keeps Home tidy.
first_run_text: Each course gets a color, and that color organizes your schedule, tasks and calendar.
first_run_s1: This term’s courses, each with a color
new_subject_desc: Only the name is required; you can fill in the rest later.
name: Name
color_hint: Identifies the course across the app. The palette is tuned to read well in light and dark mode.
delete_subject_body: Its tasks, class times, calendar dates and documents are deleted. Archiving keeps everything instead.

avg_weighted_help: Each course average is multiplied by its credits; the total is divided by the sum of those courses’ credits.
subject: Course
grades_foot: A course average is (coursework + final) ÷ 2. If either grade is missing it shows “—” and the course is left out of the averages.
grades_empty_text: Grades are entered per course. Add a course first.
delete_slot_body: It’s removed from every week. The course and its other times stay.
